_comment: C0-16 正文英译 · kagi（2026-10-25）。无附加小节。正文「相关条目」3 行带 .md 链接（perplexity/andi/metaso），related 写 3 条（frontmatter related 是 [perplexity, andi, metaso, chatgpt]，键按正文链接行对齐=3）。sources 3 条对齐 frontmatter。

axes.model_access: A self-built search index is the core story, with the answer layer made up of FastGPT, Assistant and Universal Summarizer. The official privacy page describes third-party AI providers as called per request and, where possible, not stored or used for training; no model-by-model list is published. Search is the product and AI is the add-on — the reverse of most AI-first search tools (2026-11-21).
axes.runtime: Web (kagi.com), browser extension and Mini Bar; the index is self-built while FastGPT/Assistant and summarisation run in Kagi’s cloud. Official docs offer no local model package, private deployment or offline index — the client provides UI and optional cache only (2026-11-21).
axes.local_files: Search itself writes no user files. The official privacy page lists only session/CSRF/last-page/location cookies plus kagi_sse_replay, a localStorage cache of recent result markup that avoids round trips; there is no account-level search-history store. Tor, Privacy Pass and pseudonymous email are optional anonymity paths (2026-11-21).
axes.background: Search and summarisation return synchronously; official docs list no job queue, scheduler or batch API. FastGPT/Assistant requests complete in the cloud, and closing the page leaves no resumable long-running task. Batch work must be orchestrated through the Kagi API by the caller (2026-11-21).
axes.tools: The surface includes ad-free search, FastGPT/Assistant answer lines, Universal Summarizer for URLs, video and documents, Kagi Translate and the API. The privacy page names Assistant, Summarizer, FastGPT and Translate as AI tools and states thread-retention rules (2026-11-21).
axes.context: Search is organised per query; the official privacy page says queries are not linked to an account and no profile is built. Kagi Assistant threads are deleted permanently after one day by default and can be deleted immediately, while reported threads are kept for 30 days. There is no cross-session long-term memory entry point (2026-11-21).
axes.permissions: Two levels — subscription account and API key. The official terms state that only Kagi API products are licensed for commercial use, while front-end products such as Universal Summarizer are non-commercial by default and need a separate licence. Accounts can use pseudonymous email, crypto, Tor and Privacy Pass; team/admin surfaces are not itemised in the official docs (2026-11-21).
axes.fit: Fit: users who pay for ad-free, tracking-free search, want search-plus-full-text answers and are sensitive to profiling. Not fit: free-tier-only users, Chinese-first search or organisations needing a documented enterprise audit and team-admin surface (2026-11-21).

runs: This entry checks the official privacy page and help docs for capability boundaries. Retrieval quality, Chinese coverage and the actual effect of zero-retention need a query-set test.
unknowns:
- Self-built index size and refresh frequency: the official docs do not disclose a specific index size.
- Model-by-model list behind each answer line: not published.
- Chinese-query retrieval quality: no per-language evaluation is published.
- Actual effect of zero-retention: the privacy page says queries are not account-linked, but no third-party audit report is listed in the docs.
related: Ordering contrast: Perplexity is an AI answer with search attached, Kagi is search with AI answers attached.
Also privacy-oriented AI search: Andi is free + AI answers directly, Kagi is subscription + self-built index.
Also "no ads, straight to results" slogans: Metaso is Chinese-leaning free + membership, Kagi is English-leaning subscription.
